script: Can Iraola actually fix Liverpool? Two years ago, Arne Slot took over Liverpool and won the Premier League title in his very first season, so everyone thought he was the perfect guy for the job. Then last year happened. Liverpool spent around 450 million pounds on players like Alexander Isak and Florian Wirtz, and somehow finished fifth with no trophies and 25 points behind the champions, so the club fired him. But the guy they brought in to clean up the mess had never coached a team anywhere close to this size. His name is Andoni Iraola, and he came from Bournemouth, a small club that finished sixth last season, just three points behind Liverpool. The idea was simple. Bring back that fast, high-pressing football that Jurgen Klopp used to play, and fans loved it while the players loved it even more. His first game was away at Newcastle. But ninety minutes at St James' Park exposed the exact same cracks that got the last manager fired. And if you're enjoying the content, please hit the follow button. Liverpool got outshot 20 to 13, had 39% of the ball, and lost the expected goals battle almost two to one. They were losing two to one deep into stoppage time and it looked completely done, until the ninety-ninth minute when Dominik stepped up and scored a penalty to rescue a two-two draw. So can Iraola fix Liverpool? Maybe. But it probably won't be overnight.
